// diagnostic E3542

Jet.OutputSettingWrongType

Setting `{key}` is declared `{declared}`, but this output gives it a `{given}`.

What

Setting `{key}` is declared `{declared}`, but this output gives it a `{given}`.

Why

Code reads `#build.settings.{key}` as its declared type, whichever output it is built into.

Fix

Give `{key}` a value of type `{declared}`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.OutputSettingWrongType: Tests/UI/OutputSettingWrongType/stderr.

Error: Jet.OutputSettingWrongType: Setting `max_particles` is declared `Int`, but this output gives it a `String`
  --> Tests/UI/OutputSettingWrongType/run.jet:3:91
    |
  3 |     fast: b.add_executable("fast", ["run.jet"], [], options: { settings: { max_particles: "many" } })
    |                                                                                           ^^^^^^
 Why: Code reads `#build.settings.max_particles` as its declared type, whichever output it is built into
 Fix: Give `max_particles` a value of type `Int`
